title: Cops RESCUE 1-year-old Baby From Hot Car
description:
On a hot Florida afternoon, a careless father locked his 1-year-old-daughter inside a parked car. The engine was off, the windows were closed, and the child had already been trapped for at least 8-10 minutes before officers arrived on the scene. The officers detained the father over concerns of a no-contact-order involving the mother. Upon further investigation, they also learned that the tag on the vehicle was fictitious and its ownership also under question. Although the couple could’ve been arrested and booked on multiple charges, the officer decided to give them a second chance considering the rough time that they’d been having. The father was issued a criminal citation for attaching an unassigned registration tag to a vehicle.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
